def execute_aggregation(updates, weights):

trajectory.name: Soft Inverse L2-Distance Weighting
trajectory.summary: Soft Gravity Well (Inverse-L2 weights): jumps from 1D slits to full d-dimensional Euclidean geometry (`98.48%` mitigation!), though soft weights still leak minor tail bias (`E_bar = 2.19`).
trajectory.code:
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def execute_aggregation(updates, weights):
    # G2: Soft Inverse L2-Distance Weighting
    U = np.asarray(updates, dtype=np.float64)
    dists = np.linalg.norm(U - np.median(U, axis=0), axis=1)
    w = 1.0 / (1e-4 + dists ** 2)
    return np.sum(U * (w / w.sum())[:, None], axis=0)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

trajectory.name: Evo-FedAgg Champion: BLAS Gram Top-K Filter
trajectory.summary: Relativistic BLAS Demon! Uses a single-pass `U @ U.T` snapshot (`0.38 ms`) to rank k-NN density and slam the trapdoor on the f highest-entropy outliers — 99.71% mitigation & 17.2× faster than Multi-Krum!
trajectory.code:
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def execute_aggregation(updates, weights):
    # G3 Champion (Evo-FedAgg): Vectorized BLAS Gram Top-K Filter
    U = np.asarray(updates, dtype=np.float64)
    N, f = U.shape[0], int(0.30 * len(updates))
    sq = np.sum(U * U, axis=1, keepdims=True)
    D2 = np.maximum(0.0, sq + sq.T - 2.0 * (U @ U.T))
    S = np.sum(np.partition(D2, N - f - 1, axis=1)[:, : N - f], axis=1)
    return np.mean(U[np.argsort(S)[: N - f]], axis=0)
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
